title: Welcome
description: server -> device, replies to hello once the connection is accepted: a valid hello, followed by a successful challenge/challenge_response (challenge.schema.json). A rejected hello, or a failed challenge, never gets a welcome — the connection is closed with a WS close code instead. account_id is the account signed in on this phone, or null when the phone is signed out or the server has no accounts.

accounts.description: true when this server has accounts: a phone can only be driven through the account signed in on it. false when it has none: every connected phone can be driven, account_id is always null, and sign_in is rejected with sign_in_rejected reason "accounts_unsupported".

account_id.description: The account signed in on this phone, or null when the phone is signed out or the server has no accounts.

latest_app_version.description: Newest app version the server knows of; the app compares it to its own to decide on an update banner.

minimum_supported_app_version.description: Oldest app version the server still supports; an older app shows a blocking update screen.
